manifest.name: Custom Provider Installer
manifest.description: Install custom Music Assistant providers from GitHub by URL. Lives alongside the fork's custom_providers loader — you add a repo URL here, this plugin fetches it into storage_path/custom_providers/ and pip-installs its manifest requirements, and the fork's loader picks it up on the next Music Assistant restart. Works for every provider type the loader supports: music, player, metadata, audio_analysis, plugin.

repos.label: Repository URLs
repos.description: GitHub repositories to install custom providers from, one per line. Each entry is a URL like `https://github.com/owner/repo` with an optional `@branch-or-tag` suffix (default is `main`). The archive is downloaded, the top-level provider directory is extracted into `/data/custom_providers/<domain>/`, and the provider's `requirements` are pip-installed. Changes take effect after a Music Assistant restart.
